podcast.title: Emergence from Yacht Rock
podcast.body: Yacht Soul is described as an R&B offshoot of Yacht Rock that became pivotal to Quincy Jones's career by the 1980s. It notably employed many of the same nexus of California session musicians favored by smooth bands like Steely Dan, Toto, and The Doobie Brothers. "Yacht Soul.
